name: design-artifacts-export-driver
description: The export driver the design-artifacts workflows run: @design-parity/export-driver at an exact version, with its whole dependency tree locked in package-lock.json. The workflows install it with `npm ci` through .github/scripts/install-export-driver.sh, so a privileged job runs exactly this reviewed tree and nothing the registry resolves on the day. Renovate moves the version and the lock together.
